The other three had their work merged to main first (PR #1, #2, #3); this session integrated them instead of replacing them — see the preserved-artifacts table in README.md and docs/legacy/. Two of those sessions recorded that their sandbox could not reach retailer pages, which is why their catalogs are empty. That was a tooling limit, not evidence that no ring can be verified: this session could read the retailer pages, so the dataset is populated and every populated value carries the page it came from. Nothing in any other branch was deleted, renamed or force-pushed. A fifth session, arena/1372cb32-gold4, ran an independent pass-3 re-verification of every official page behind the dataset (task 10 on the board): all 19 published prices and all 6 published gram weights were re-read and matched exactly, one previously blank weight (AN-01) was recovered from the retailer's own Product Details table, and new page inconsistencies were flagged (Mejuri variant-redirect links, VRAI pavé spec on plain-band settings). See passes 4 and 5 below.
